title: The PWDG-UWVF Equivalence Revisited
summary: The ultra-weak variational formulation (UWVF) is known to be the Trefftz discontinuous Galerkin scheme obtained from the standard PWDG flux family by setting \(α=β=δ=1/2\). We give a short structural explanation of this fact. On every interior mesh edge, the two PWDG jump terms at these parameter values are exactly one half of the sum of the squared norms of the two oriented impedance-transmission defects used by the UWVF.
